propositions: On Data Center, outbound status updates are submitted as field edits via issue.update(fields=...) instead of being routed through transition_issue_by_name, causing Jira to reject the status value and leaving the issue in its original state.

The Cloud transport (acli.py) pops status from kwargs and routes it to transition_issue, but the Data Center transport (transport.py) does not, allowing status to pass through to the REST field edit where it is not a valid editable field.
The status-to-transition resolution logic implemented in bug 7f93 for transition_issue_by_name is unreachable from the outbound apply path on Data Center because update_issue never calls it.

JiraDataCenterTransport.update_issue must extract status from kwargs and route it through transition_issue_by_name while keeping other allowlisted fields in the field edit, matching the Cloud transport behavior.
Illegal transitions should remain non-fatal and surface as observable bridge alerts rather than silently failing, preserving the existing soft-failure contract.
